title: Cloud Sleeve Ruffle Tulle Slit Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Cloud Sleeve Ruffle Tulle Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Off-shoulder maternity photoshoot gown with feathery cloud tulle sleeves and a ruffled tulle skirt with a high slit and train. US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a fitted off-the-shoulder gown with soft cloud-like tulle sleeves, a gathered sweetheart bodice that follows the bump, and a skirt of ruffled tulle tiers that opens at the front with a high slit and trails behind you.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.

sweetheart bodice gathered over the bump, short puffed ruffled-tulle sleeves worn off the shoulders, a fitted shape through the hips, and a tiered ruffled-tulle skirt with a high front slit and long train.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust and hips today, and size up if you want extra room over the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
garment_lock: an off-the-shoulder maternity gown with a smooth fitted sweetheart bodice that is softly gathered and crossed over the bump, short puffed sleeves of ruffled sheer tulle worn off the shoulders, a fitted mermaid shape through the hips, and a skirt of cascading tiers of ruffled tulle with a high front slit and a long sweeping train
